id: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales (2017)

facts.why: The Dying Gull is Jack's ship, not a tavern. The compass is traded in an unnamed local tavern on St Martin.
facts.fix: Aboard the Dying Gull, last call

facts.why: The summaries read show Salazar's ghost crew and the Silent Mary but no ghost sharks.

facts.text: Ghost sharks of the Devil's Triangle
facts.why: Same problem as the dish name.
facts.fix: Salazar's ghost ship, the Silent Mary

vibe.verdict: Good use of the compass cue and the Dying Gull, but it calls the ship a tavern and misses a few big moments.
missing: The bank vault dragged through town (St Martin)
Carina escaping the witchcraft execution (St Martin)
The sea parting to walk to the Trident (Trident island)
Barbossa's death and the monkey Jack (finale)
The Black Pearl released from the bottle (the voyage)
Henry meeting Will on the Dutchman (opening)
ideas: Swap the 'Dockside tavern' sign for 'Aboard the Dying Gull'.
Swap 'Steamed guava duff pudding' for a 'Bank vault pudding' with a gold coin.
Swap 'Parmesan thyme crisps' for 'Where's the dosh?' bar snacks (Scrum's line).
Swap the 'Reunion pork belly' note for Barbossa's last stand.
